examples.arabic: اخيرا لقيت بلوزة حلوة وسعرها مناسب واشتريتها
examples.english: Finally, I found a nice blouse and its price was suitable, and I bought it.
examples.transliteration: Akheeran laqeet bloozeh helweh w sa'erha monaseb w ashtaraytha

examples.arabic: جدي راح عالمحل امبارح واشترى بلوزة
examples.english: My grandfather went to the shop yesterday and bought a blouse.
examples.transliteration: Jaddi rah al-mahall imbareh w ishtara bluzeh.
